name: avo-register-use-ledger
instr:
Avo cannot report how authored operands participate in instructions, remain live, and acquire physical bindings during compilation. Add an opt-in register-use ledger that makes allocation and transformation decisions reproducible and agrees with emitted Go assembly. Without reporting, behavior must not change.

Preserve operand occurrence order and identity. Distinguish explicit, read, write, address-base, and address-index roles, including cancelling idioms and repeated operands. Deterministically report compatible unrestricted candidates, interference rejections, and the selected physical identity for every virtual identity.

Each completed-stage ledger must atomically reflect current function order, control flow, deterministic instruction-level live-in and live-out identities from the current control-flow graph, binding origins, verification, and cleanup. Do not expose partial stages or stale nodes. Authored physical registers are self-originating; bound virtual occurrences retain their authored origin. Callers may obtain deterministic ledgers at every stable lifecycle boundary, including before compilation, after each completed analysis stage, and after successful compilation.

Compilation and collection failures, including malformed register participation and incomplete binding, remain ordinary compilation errors.
